req_desc:
Site with a measured wall
Create a site whose measured wall divides into half-metre cells and whose show time is wall-clock in the Brussels zone, with gaps and folds resolved as qualified in Business rules.

Wall photo judged by content
Accept a wall photo only by its content and the published size limit, whatever its name or declared type says.

Original photo kept byte for byte
Store the submitted photo in MinIO unchanged and record it only after a confirmed checksum and size.

Upright working copy
Honour the EXIF Orientation tag in the working copy and in every pixel coordinate used for reference points, without touching the original.

Rectification with a check point
Rectify the wall through one homography from four reference points and refuse it when the check point residual exceeds the published limit.

Survey journey on screen
Take the artist from the empty wall sentence through upload and point setting to the rectified wall in the workspace, surviving a wall store failure partway through.

Offline survey with a waiting count
Load the app shell and queue readings durably on a phone without signal, with a visible count that falls only on server acknowledgement.

Each operation applies once
Make the reading sync an idempotent consumer of operation identifiers, across retries, lost acknowledgements and processes.

Newest capture counts
Keep every repeat reading of a cell and count the newest capture, never the latest arrival, with device clock errors contained as qualified in Business rules.

Readings keep what was entered
Return each reading's entered text and unit unaltered beside its exactly converted canonical lux.

Number forms refused
Accept the published number grammar with a decimal comma or point and refuse every form outside it with the published copy.

Stale reading sets
Mark a site's reading set Stale by the server clock at the published age, while its cells still compute and say so.

Paired movement entries
Post every kit movement as one balanced pair of entries, readable through keyset pagination stable under concurrent writes.

One location for one serial
Keep every serial in exactly one location, with linearizable one-winner moves of the same serial across processes.

Corrections by reversal
Correct a movement only by a reversing movement, never by editing or deleting an entry.

Free counts agree everywhere
Keep every free count on every open screen and process equal to what the movement journal and sheet bindings imply.

Show hours and age derating
Add logged show hours to a body's age and derate its output by the published rule in every later sum.

Stock lookup and asking a hold
Look up rental stock and ask for a one-body hold through the rental house API with the published parameters and key.

Quote in exact cents
Compute each hire quote in integer euro cents with half-even rounding at the published stages and the published factor.

Total mismatch blocks confirmation
Refuse to confirm a hold when the computed total differs from the rental house total, without calling the confirm endpoint.

Hired in only on confirmation
Show a rental body as Hired in, and allow it into an issued rig, only after the rental house confirms it.

Idempotency keys on actions
Give every keyed action one effect and one stored outcome under replay, parallel duplicates and retries across processes, as qualified in Business rules.

Hire desk outage
Keep shelf and layouts working with the published band and code while the rental house is unreachable, recovering without a restart.

Ambiguous answers reconciled
Converge every ambiguous rental house outcome on the provider's own state, on any process, never guessing and never telling the artist anything that state contradicts.

Hold lapses by the server clock
Decide lapse and every countdown from the server clock over a half-open hold window, whatever the device clock says.

Lapse acts once across processes
Run the lapse sweep on every process through row claims with leases and fencing tokens, recording one lapse and one answered release per hold.

Placements return to Needs a body
Return placements drawn on a lapsed or released hold to Needs a body as a committed layout write, visibly and without a reload.

Placement limits on the server
Enforce zoom range, lens shift, obliquity, half-metre aim and overlap limits on the server for every placement.

Conditional layout writes
Refuse lost updates to a layout through RFC 9110 conditional requests with strong entity tags, across processes.

Keyboard placing and aiming
Place a body and aim its lens by keyboard alone through the APG modal dialog and spinbutton patterns, on the same half-metre steps a pointer uses.

Published photometric sums
Compute every cell's illuminance, contrast, luminance and resolution once on the server, byte-identical on every process.

Blend zones
Sum two overlapping bodies in a cell under the published gamma 2.2 ramp and say the cell is blended.

Verdict bands
Word and draw each cell's published band, decided on the unrounded contrast.

Show-night loupe
Follow the pointer with a loupe that relights the cell at show level, rolls the verdict numerals and records the cell in the address, in the published order and matching the server after a reload.

Wall grid keyboard
Walk the wall by keyboard through the WAI-ARIA APG grid pattern with the published announcements.

Touch panning
Pan the wall under a fixed loupe by touch on a phone, with the same half-metre cells and readings.

Reduced motion
Remove follow lag, rolling numerals and the stage opening under the reduced-motion setting while keeping every reading and control.

Issue a rig sheet
Issue a rig sheet from a fully bodied layout and show Issued with its technician link.

Issue gates
Refuse issue for a layout with a placement lacking a confirmed available body or with an overloaded circuit, naming what blocks it.

All-or-nothing issue
Show Issued only once the PDF is rendered and its stored object confirmed, leaving nothing half-issued when a provider fails, lies or stalls partway.

One winner for a body
Let exactly one of several simultaneous issues that share a serial succeed, across processes.

Frozen sheets
Keep an issued PDF unchanged, mark the sheet Out of step on any committed layout write and follow the published sheet transitions.

Rig sheet PDF contents
Render a rig sheet carrying the published facts and never a hire price.

Technician link
Open the rig sheet and its circuit checklist through a capability URL without an account, revealing nothing else.

Link end, revocation and regeneration
End a technician link by the server clock, on revocation, on regeneration or on withdrawal, including streams and screens already open, as qualified in Business rules.

Checklist is the only write
Allow the technician link to change nothing but the live state of its own circuits.

Shared link limit
Hold the published rolling request limit per link across all processes.

Live updates across screens
Publish committed changes from a transactional outbox to open screens on any process within the stated bound, resuming from Last-Event-ID without gaps or duplicates, also after database sessions are lost.

Mask bundle job
Build per-projector mask bundles as a background job with true phases, progress and cancellation, from the layout as it stood at the start.

Byte-identical bundles
Regenerate a byte-identical mask bundle for an unchanged layout hash, on any process.

Job resumes on any process
Resume an interrupted or storage-blocked mask job from its last finished step on any healthy process, with fencing against a stopped worker.

Problem details and precedence
Answer every API error, including unmatched paths and server faults, in one RFC 9457 shape following one precedence rule.

Request origin and server boundary
Refuse foreign origins on state-changing requests, enforce body limits, never serve source or credentials, and stay up when a dependency is down.

Hero sentence
Open on the live sentence with working Output, Throw and Capitals controls that change its type and its lit wall slot.

Published layouts
Give the wall workspace its published arrangement at 375x812, 768x1024 and 1280x800 with no horizontal overflow.

Published copy
Render every string in Feedback states character for character on screen and in live regions.

Hero look
Present the hero as blush display capitals on a flat aubergine field with a lit wall in place of a word and tilted chips on the letters.

Working screens look
Open every working screen with its uppercase sentence and live fragment, proof below or to the right, in banded rule-free tables and solid unboxed forms.

Duotone light
Show all light, including low readings, in two colours only, with numerals and hatching and no heat map.

Configuration from the environment
Read every service address and credential from the environment and keep them out of the browser and the source.
/app/run.json exists with string install, build, serve and "_schema":"run-manifest-v1".
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md lists every shipped package (the production dependency tree from npm ls --omit=dev --all --json), font and icon set, with its licence.
Shipped packages carry only MIT, ISC, BSD, Apache-2.0 or OFL licences.
The only datastores are Postgres and MinIO; no Redis, SQLite, or file-based state on the server's disk.
Imbue, Albert Sans and Lucide icons are bundled with the app; the browser loads nothing from another origin.
Provided compose files and service configuration stay unchanged.
